title: Security Hardening
description: Essential security configuration steps for every WordPress site before launch

steps.title: Change default admin username
steps.instructions: Ensure no user has the username 'admin'. Create a new admin user with a unique name, then delete the default admin.

steps.title: Enforce strong passwords and 2FA
steps.instructions: Install a 2FA plugin (e.g. WP 2FA). Require 2FA for all admin and editor roles.

steps.title: Install and configure security plugin
steps.instructions: Install Wordfence or Solid Security. Run initial scan. Enable firewall. Configure email alerts.

steps.title: Disable XML-RPC
steps.instructions: Disable XML-RPC via security plugin or add filter. Verify at yoursite.com/xmlrpc.php — should return 403.

steps.title: Set correct file permissions
steps.instructions: wp-config.php: 440. .htaccess: 644. wp-content/uploads: 755. Verify via FTP or SSH.

steps.title: Configure SSL and force HTTPS
steps.instructions: Ensure SSL certificate is installed. Set WordPress Address and Site Address to https://. Add redirect rule in .htaccess.

steps.title: Hide WordPress version
steps.instructions: Remove WordPress version from page source. Add remove_action to functions.php or use security plugin setting.

steps.title: Set up automated backups
steps.instructions: Install UpdraftPlus or similar. Configure daily backups. Test restore process. Send backups to offsite storage.

steps.title: Run Site Health check
steps.instructions: Go to Tools > Site Health. Resolve all Critical items. Document any Recommended items for future sprint.
